title: 第三百四十三章 抵达长安第三百四十二章 时来运转
lines: 第两百四十三章：抵达长安
从宋国到大汉朝帝都长安，一路要横穿五个诸侯国，分别是元国、明国、周国、金国、真番国。五国中，元国和宋国是世仇，每隔三五年总要爆发一次或大或小的战争，其他四国和宋国或者交好，或者敌对，关系也只能算是一般。
唯恐朱易的身份被沿途诸侯国的人知晓，离开宋国疆土进入元国境后，护送朱易的大队人马纷纷改换了装束，将精良的军用制式铠甲，换成了民间富商才会使用的甲胄，所有坐骑兵器也都做了相应的更改。
就连十二架飞车上的徽章，也都换成了宋国一个豪富世家，专营铁器生意的‘陶家’的标志。打着去长安求学的幌子，朱易一行四千多人用最快的速度，一路直奔长安而去。
当今当世，大汉朝的诸侯国纷争不休，各国疆土之内也不甚平静。但是一个豪富世家的嫡系公子出游，携带四千多护卫门客，实在是太夸张了一些。不过如果随行的车队里还有数十车金玉珠宝，这就变得顺理成章的了。庞大的队伍一路日夜兼程，顶风冒雨的向长安进发。
元国、明国、周国，一个个诸侯国被抛在了身后。除了在元国内被沿途的官吏敲诈，花费了一笔不小的费用做买路费，在经过其他诸侯国时，队伍并没有受到刁难。
两个月后，当随行的骑士坐下的坐骑都瘦了一圈，原本健壮的异兽坐骑都已经瘦得可以当柴禾棒烧掉的时候，一行人终于离开真番国，进入了大汉朝直辖的疆土。从这里一条官道走到底，途径八个郡，两百四十二城，走过两万二千五百余里，就是大汉朝的帝都长安所在。
在车架上憋了近两个月，早就憋得五脏六腑烟火直冒，七窍都快喷火的叶重坐在飞车顶部，呆呆的看着前方一望无垠的平原。
以车队的速度，日夜兼程二十天，就能到达长安。如果不是那些装载了金玉珠宝的车辆，拖慢了车队的速度，他们还能提前几天赶到。
叶重站起身来，眺望了一下四面八方无边无际的大地，一缕水汽慢慢的从他嘴里喷出了三丈远。拳头大小的天水灵蛇丹滴溜溜飞起，乖乖的从他丹田前飞回了储物袋。
两个月日夜兼程，两个月苦心潜修，叶重在半步武王境界，用元气将经脉强化三百六十五次后，终于顺利的突破到了武王境界。虽然他此刻的经脉，已经比其他武王锻体境界的修炼者还要宽敞坚韧，但是这并不妨碍他在武王阶段将自身的经脉再次淬炼一遍。
“万界决”，原本就是和正统的修炼功法大相庭径的功法。
空中突然传来一声悦耳的鹰啼，一只娇小的白色鹰隼从高空飞射而下，化为一道白光钻进了梅青竹的车厢。过了一阵，梅青竹突然大笑着从车厢里走了出来，一步就跨到了朱易所在的车驾上。
低头钻进车里，梅青竹很是欢喜的笑了起来：“朱易，你的那些竞争对手，此刻只剩下了三人，其他人全部被顺利击杀。现在那三人距离大汉朝的疆土还有半个月的路程。不出意外，你父亲留下的那些东西，全部是你的了。”。
梅青竹的笑声中，充满了说不完道不尽的得意。
按照大汉朝宗律，一旦朱易继承了刘琦的遗产，她也将得到大汉朝的册封。虽然她已经嫁了人，但是这并不妨碍她，成为大汉朝真正意义上的顶级贵妇。她的儿子是大汉朝的公爵，那么她被册封的夫人封号，就绝对不会在公爵之下，也许她将可位比王爵。
大汉朝册封的夫人，那可比宋国国君给她的荣阳夫人的封号尊贵一万倍！荣阳城？那不过是宋国的一座人口不到五万的小城。而大汉朝一个顶级的夫人封号，起码也会有数十座大城做为食邑。
不用进车厢，叶重都能感受到梅青竹身上散发出的，一种叫做野心的疯狂气焰。也许当朱易继承了刘琦留下的一切，宋国就该改名叫做朱国了吧？
朱易清冷的声音传了出来，他和梅青竹开始计算，要如何才能顺利的将刘琦留下的东西得到手。虽然大汉朝国宗府已经做出决定，刘琦最先赶到长安的孩子将继承他的一切，但是谁知道里面有没有变卦呢？两郡的封地，这对大汉朝的很多人也是有很大诱惑力的。
两人悉悉索索的盘算着可能出现的一切变故，叶重对这些盘算不感兴趣，他纵身跳起，几个起落就到了车队最后面一辆飞车内。
闪身进了车厢，叶重掏出火石，点着了车厢角落里烛台上的白蜡。
这架飞车的车窗被厚厚的毡子挡住，车厢里伸手不见五指。暗淡的灯火亮起，躺在车厢正中的两个男子突然轻轻的哼了一声，身体不自然的动了几下，他们双眼被灯火刺激，忙不迭的眨起眼睛。叶重轻挥了一下手，低声咳嗽了一声。
盘坐在车厢角落里的几个许村大汉笑呵呵的点了点头，起身走出了车厢，站在了驾车的车夫身后。叶重走到那两个男子身边，盘膝坐下，然后将两人扶起，让他们靠在了软垫上。
胡须拉杂，面容憔悴至极，脸部轮廓瘦了一大圈，双眼凸起显得又大又亮的苏定、张松死死的盯着叶重，而一旁的苏定也是哑声笑道：“叶重，你又来劝我们？嘿，我们不会背弃君侯的，我们就算死，也不会投靠朱易。要我们做他的门客，不可能！”。
这两个男子，正是苏定和张松。
两个多月前，梅青竹指挥黑甲铁骑全歼了他们麾下军队，朱家四个武王供奉围攻二人，将二人重伤后生擒活捉。在叶重的要求下，两人被封禁了丹田元气囚禁在了这架大车上，一路跟着大队人马赶了两个多月的路。
大半年的时间没有动弹，就好像活死人一样躺在车厢里，苏定和张松早就被折腾得连死都不如。
叶重每隔两天，就会过来问他们是否愿意投靠朱易。但是两人的回答起初总是一模一样的破口大骂，从来不给叶重好脸色看。到了后来，两人元气被封禁得太久，浑身没力，他们也懒得骂了，每次叶重来，他们就是有气无力的哼哼几声，也懒得搭理叶重。
盘膝坐着，叶重望着两人长叹了一声。
也不理会两人的态度，叶重一五一十的将朱易的出生来历告诉了两人。并且明白的告诉他们，朱易如今已经在继承刘琦的遗产争斗中，占据了绝对的优势，如果不出意外，朱易将成为大汉朝的公爵，顶级的皇族宗室贵族，拥有极大权力的大汉朝左国正。
“我们公子，需要两位的加入。”，叶重直白的说道，“我们公子如今的实力，不能保证他未来的利益。两位如果愿意投顺我们公子，荣华富贵，是少不了你们的。如果不投靠我们公子，我现在就废了你们全部修为，等朱家将宋国王室取而代之之后，你们的九族不保也是难免的事情。”。
苏定和张松闻言大惊，两人犹如见鬼一样看着叶重，半晌没回过神来。
叶重看着两人，淡淡的说道：“大概还有二十日，我们就能到长安。在到达长安之前，你们起码需要半个月时间运功调息恢复功力。今天是你们最后的机会，今天你们不投靠我们公子，过几天，你们也没用了。”。
张松死死的盯着叶重，随即便是沉声道：“我们怎么也是武王境界的宗师。”。
叶重摇了摇头：“那又怎么样？你们输得太惨，没资格考虑面子的问题。”。
苏定同样死死的盯着叶重，而后却是冷笑道：“如果我们执意不投靠呢？”。
叶重一掌劈下，狠狠的劈在了苏定的丹田上，阴柔的体内的元气透体而入，差点就震碎了苏定的丹田。一口逆血喷出，苏定脸色顿时变得惨白一片。他又惊又怕的看着叶重，刚才这一掌，叶重真的差点破掉了他的修为。
“不投靠，废掉你们修为，然后让你们亲眼看着，你们满门老小是怎么死的。”，叶重讥嘲的看着面色难看的苏定和张松道，“说实话，两个武王武者，对我们公子的意义不是很大，你们应该心知肚明。”。
面对即将继承刘琦全部遗产的朱易，两个武王武者，似乎真不算什么。苏定和张松相互看了看，心头最后一丝异心都消失得无影无踪。
过了许久，张松才干涩的说道：“既然要投靠朱易公子为门客，难道我们就这么去见他？”。

Chapter 243: Arrival in Chang'an
From the Song Dynasty to Chang'an, the imperial capital of the Han Dynasty, we have to cross five vassal states, namely the Yuan Kingdom, the Ming Kingdom, the Zhou Kingdom, the Jin Kingdom, and the Zhenfan Kingdom. Among the five kingdoms, the Yuan Kingdom and the Song Kingdom were feuding, and a major or minor war would break out every three to five years. The other four kingdoms were either friendly or hostile to the Song Kingdom, and their relationship could only be considered average.
For fear that Zhu Yi's identity would be known to people in the vassal states along the way, after leaving the territory of the Song Dynasty and entering the Yuan Kingdom, the large group of people escorting Zhu Yi changed their clothes one after another, replacing the sophisticated military-style armor with armor used by wealthy private merchants. All cavalry equipment were also changed accordingly.
Even the badges on the twelve flying cars have been replaced with the logo of the 'Tao Family', a wealthy family in the Song Dynasty that specializes in the iron business. Under the guise of going to Chang'an to study, Zhu Yi and his party of more than 4,000 people headed straight to Chang'an as fast as possible.
In today's world, the vassal states of the Han Dynasty are constantly arguing, and there is no peace within the territories of each country. But for a direct son of a wealthy family to travel with more than 4,000 escorts and followers, it is really an exaggeration. But if there are dozens of cars of gold, jade and jewelry in the accompanying convoy, this becomes logical. The huge team marched day and night, heading towards Chang'an in the wind and rain.
The Yuan, Ming, and Zhou vassal states were left behind one after another. Except for being extorted by officials along the way in the Yuan Dynasty and spending a large sum of money to pay for travel expenses, the team did not encounter any difficulties when passing through other vassal states.
Two months later, when the mounts of the accompanying knights had lost a lot of weight, and the originally strong beast mounts were so thin that they could be burned as firewood, the group finally left Zhenfan Country and entered the territory directly governed by the Han Dynasty. From here, an official road goes to the end, passing through eight counties, 242 cities, and covering more than 22,500 miles, to where Chang'an, the imperial capital of the Han Dynasty, is located.
After holding it in for nearly two months, Ye Zhong was so suffocated that his internal organs were bursting with smoke and his orifices were about to burst into flames. He sat on the top of the speeding car and stared blankly at the endless plain in front of him.
At the speed of the convoy, it would take twenty days of traveling day and night to reach Chang'an. If it weren't for the vehicles loaded with gold and jade jewelry that slowed down the convoy, they could have arrived a few days earlier.
Ye Zhong stood up and looked at the boundless land in all directions. A wisp of water vapor slowly sprayed out from his mouth three feet away. The fist-sized Heavenly Water Spirit Snake Pill flew up and flew obediently from his Dantian back to the storage bag.
After two months of working day and night, and two months of painstaking cultivation, Ye Zhong was at the half-step Martial King realm, and after using his vitality to strengthen his meridians 365 times, he finally successfully broke through to the Martial King realm. Although his meridians at this moment are already wider and tougher than those of other cultivators in the King of Martial Realm, this does not prevent him from tempering his meridians again in the King of Martial Stage.
"The Art of Ten Thousand Realms" is originally a technique that is very different from the orthodox cultivation technique.
Suddenly there was a sweet eagle cry in the air, and a petite white falcon flew down from the sky, turning into a white light and getting into Mei Qingzhu's carriage. After a while, Mei Qingzhu suddenly laughed and walked out of the car, and stepped onto the car where Zhu Yi was.
Lowering his head and getting into the car, Mei Qingzhu laughed happily: "Zhu Yi, there are only three of your competitors left at this moment, and all the others have been successfully killed. Now those three are still half a month away from the territory of the Han Dynasty. As expected, all the things your father left behind are yours."
Mei Qingzhu's laughter was filled with endless pride.
According to the ancestral laws of the Han Dynasty, once Zhu Yi inherits Liu Qi's inheritance, she will also be canonized by the Han Dynasty. Although she is married, this does not prevent her from becoming a top noblewoman in the true sense of the Han Dynasty. Her son is a duke of the Han Dynasty, so the title of the lady she is canonized will definitely not be under the duke. Maybe she will be comparable to the king.
The lady canonized by the Han Dynasty was ten thousand times more noble than the title of Lady Rongyang given to her by the King of Song Dynasty! Rongyang City? It was just a small town in the Song Dynasty with a population of less than 50,000. In the Han Dynasty, a top lady title would have at least dozens of big cities as food towns.
Without even entering the carriage, Ye Zhong could feel the crazy arrogance called ambition emanating from Mei Qingzhu. Maybe when Zhu Yi inherits everything Liu Qi left, the Song State should be renamed Zhu State, right?
Zhu Yi's cold voice came out, and he and Mei Qingzhu began to calculate how to successfully get what Liu Qi left behind. Although the Imperial Palace of the Han Dynasty has made a decision that Liu Qi's child who was the first to arrive in Chang'an will inherit everything from him, but who knows if there has been any change? The fiefdoms of the two counties were also very attractive to many people in the Han Dynasty.
The two of them carefully planned all the possible changes. Ye Chong was not interested in these calculations. He jumped up and reached the last flying car in the convoy after a few ups and downs.
Ye Zhong ducked into the carriage, took out a flint, and lit the white wax on the candlestick in the corner of the carriage.
The windows of this flying car were blocked by thick felt, making it impossible to see anyone inside the car. The dim lights came on, and the two men lying in the middle of the carriage suddenly snorted softly, and their bodies moved unnaturally a few times. Their eyes were stimulated by the lights, and they blinked hurriedly. Ye Zhong waved his hand lightly and coughed quietly.
Several big men from Xu Village who were sitting cross-legged in the corner of the carriage nodded with a smile, stood up and walked out of the carriage, standing behind the driver. Ye Zhong walked to the two men, sat down cross-legged, then lifted them up and let them lean on the soft cushions.
Su Ding and Zhang Song, who had unkempt beards, extremely haggard faces, a large circle of thin face, and bulging eyes that looked big and bright, stared at Ye Chong, while Su Ding on the side also laughed hoarsely and said: "Ye Chong, are you here to persuade us again? Hey, we will not abandon the monarch. Even if we die, we will not join Zhu Yi. It is impossible for us to be his disciples!".
These two men were Su Ding and Zhang Song.
More than two months ago, Mei Qingzhu commanded the black-armored cavalry to annihilate all their troops. The four martial kings of the Zhu family surrounded the two men, seriously injuring them and capturing them alive. At Ye Zhong's request, the two of them had their Dantian vitality blocked and imprisoned in this cart, following the group for more than two months.
They had not moved for more than half a year, lying in the carriage like living dead. Su Ding and Zhang Song had been tortured to the point where they were worse than dead.
Every two days, Ye Chong would come over and ask them if they were willing to join Zhu Yi. But the two people's answers at first were always the same, swearing, and they never looked down upon Ye Chong. Later, the two people's vitality had been blocked for too long and they were so weak that they didn't bother to scold him. Every time Ye Zhong came, they just grunted feebly and didn't bother to talk to Ye Zhong.
Sitting cross-legged, Ye Chong looked at the two of them and sighed.
Ignoring their attitudes, Ye Zhong told them Zhu Yi's birth history. And clearly told them that Zhu Yi now has an absolute advantage in the battle to inherit Liu Qi's inheritance. If nothing happens, Zhu Yi will become the Duke of the Han Dynasty, the top royal family noble, and Zuo Guozheng of the Han Dynasty who has great power.
"Our young master, we need two people to join us." Ye Zhong said bluntly, "Our young master's current strength cannot guarantee his future interests. If you two are willing to surrender to our young master, you will be indispensable for your prosperity and wealth. If you don't surrender to our young master, I will abolish all your cultivations now. After the Zhu family replaces the royal family of the Song Dynasty, it is inevitable that your nine clans will not be protected."
Su Ding and Zhang Song were shocked when they heard this. They looked at Ye Chong as if they had seen a ghost and did not recover for a long time.
Ye Zhong looked at the two of them and said calmly: "We will arrive in Chang'an in about twenty days. Before arriving in Chang'an, you will need at least half a month to exercise and adjust your breath to restore your skills. Today is your last chance. If you don't join our master today, you will be useless in a few days."
Zhang Song stared at Ye Chong, and then said in a deep voice: "How come we are also the masters of King Wu realm.".
Ye Chong shook his head: "So what? You lost so miserably that you have no right to consider the issue of face.".
Su Ding also stared at Ye Chong, and then sneered: "What if we insist on not surrendering?".
Ye Zhong struck down with a palm, hitting Su Ding's dantian hard. The vitality in Yinrou's body penetrated into her body, almost shattering Su Ding's dantian. A mouthful of blood spurted out, and Su Ding's face suddenly turned pale. He looked at Ye Zhong in shock and fear. With that palm just now, Ye Zhong really almost destroyed his cultivation.
"If you don't surrender, your cultivation will be destroyed, and then you will see with your own eyes how all the young and old in your family died." Ye Zhong looked mockingly at Su Ding and Zhang Song, who looked ugly, and said, "To be honest, the two Martial King warriors don't mean much to our young master. You should know it well."
Facing Zhu Yi, who was about to inherit Liu Qi's entire inheritance, two Wu Wang warriors seemed to be nothing. Su Ding and Zhang Song looked at each other, and the last trace of dissatisfaction in their hearts disappeared without a trace.
After a long time, Zhang Song said dryly: "Since we want to take refuge with Mr. Zhu Yi as a retainer, should we just go to see him like this?".
title_en: Chapter 343: Arrival in Chang'an Chapter 342: Things turn out differently
